name: ECU Cost of Living Support Bursary
summary: An automatic cost-of-living bursary ECU offers to domestic students it identifies as likely to need support.
who: Meets Australian Government eligibility criteria and is identified by ECU from equity indicators.
how: You can't apply. Eligible students are notified by 16 October 2026 and accept in the student portal.
catches: Accept before the offer expires (closes 31 December 2026). The amount varies between students.

source.label: ECU: Cost of Living Support Bursary

evidence.quote: You cannot apply for this bursary.
If you are eligible to receive this bursary, you will be notified by 16 October 2026.
